title: HF2237 (2023-2024 Regular): Permit to carry application and renewal process modified.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-27; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/2237/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced text as filed (2023-02-27). No votes recorded. Bill shows no struck words; the application text is mostly existing law. Quotes are not in page order; the first quote is the opening sentence of paragraph (g).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (g) This subdivision prescribes the complete and exclusive set of items an applicant is required to submit in order to apply for a new or renewal permit to carry.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (e) Applications for new permits must be submitted in person. Applications for permit renewals may be submitted in person, electronically, or by United States mail.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (j) Upon receipt of an application packet and any required fee, the sheriff must provide a signed receipt indicating the date of submission.
Section 2 (temporary modification): (b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 624.714, during a peacetime public health emergency a sheriff may require a person applying for or renewing a permit to carry in person to make an appointment to submit the application packet if the sheriff determines that this is warranted to prevent or reduce the spread of COVID-19 and the sheriff is requiring appointments for other similar matters.
